description:
These are just some quick graphics that I whipped up for a possibility of koopa replacements for my game : The Star World.

If you want to use these, feel free. No credit is needed. Just contact me and let me know you're using them. I like seeing my work in action. :)

The ExGFX info is in the zip folder. Custom Palette is included. Hope you all enjoy. :)

-Mariowings77
